source: cf-cc-research workflow (4 agents, cloudflare-docs + web search)

endpoints.notes: Account Settings Read (or any token with account membership). Lists accounts the token/user can access. Paginates via page & per_page.
Account Settings Read. Returns account name, settings (e.g. enforce_twofactor), type.
Account: Account Membership Read (a.k.a. Members Read). Each member includes user email, status, and assigned roles/policies. Paginates.
Account Settings Read. Lists roles available in the account (id, name, permissions) for resolving member role refs. Paginates. Get one: GET /accounts/{account_id}/roles/{role_id}.
Account: Billing Read (Subscriptions). Returns account-level subscriptions/billing rate plans. Zone-level plan also visible via zone.plan in GET /zones/{zone_id}. User-level: GET /user/subscriptions.
User Details Read. Only works with an API token tied to a user (not an Account-Owned token). Returns email, id, 2FA status, etc.
User API Tokens Read. Returns token metadata only (id, name, status, policies, last_used_on, expires_on) — never the secret value. Paginates. Verify a token: GET /user/tokens/verify.
Zone Read. Filter to one account with ?account.id={account_id}. Each zone includes id, name, status, plan, name_servers, account ref. Paginates (page, per_page up to 50).
Zone Read. Full detail for a single zone including plan/billing tier and original/vanity name servers.
DNS Read (Zone: DNS Read). Lists all DNS records. Paginates (page, per_page up to 100, or use cursor). For account-level internal DNS use the views API.

Zone Settings Read. Returns ALL zone settings in one array (ssl, min_tls_version, always_use_https, http2/3, brotli, security_level, browser_check, etc.). Single setting: GET /zones/{zone_id}/settings/{setting_id}. Not paginated.
SSL and Certificates Read. Lists edge certificate packs (universal/advanced/custom). Add ?status=all to include non-active. Paginates.

Zone Settings Read. SSL/TLS encryption mode (off | flexible | full | strict). Recommended/encrypt-mode detail: GET /zones/{zone_id}/settings/ssl_recommender. Also see /zones/{zone_id}/settings/min_tls_version.
DNS Read (DNSSEC). Returns DNSSEC status (active/pending/disabled), DS record, DNSKEY, algorithm, multi-signer flag. Not paginated.

Verified via ruleset-engine docs. New WAF engine: zone custom firewall rules entry point ruleset (includes the rules array). Token: Zone WAF Read (or Account Filter Lists/Firewall). Not paginated — one ruleset object with rules[].
Verified via ruleset-engine docs. Rate limiting rules entry point ruleset (new engine). Phase name is http_ratelimit. Token: Zone WAF Read / Rate Limiting Read. Not paginated.

Verified. Lists ALL rulesets in a zone (every phase: managed deployment, custom, ratelimit, transform, etc.). Use to discover phases/ids, then fetch each with GET /zones/{zone_id}/rulesets/{ruleset_id}. Token: Zone WAF Read. Paginates.
Verified. Fetch a single ruleset (and its rules[]) by id — used to expand managed/custom rulesets discovered from the list. Token: Zone WAF Read.
Verified pattern. Entry point ruleset that DEPLOYS Cloudflare Managed Rulesets / OWASP at zone level (each rule references a managed ruleset id + overrides). Token: Zone WAF Read.
Zone Firewall Services Read. DEPRECATED legacy firewall rules (paired with /zones/{zone_id}/filters). Still readable for migration/audit; new deployments use rulesets. Paginates.
Zone Firewall Services Read. Legacy filter expressions referenced by legacy firewall rules. DEPRECATED. Paginates.

Page Rules Read (Zone). Legacy Page Rules. Returns array of rules with targets/actions/priority/status. Supports order/direction/match query params; effectively a single page (not cursor/page paginated).
Cache Rules live in the ruleset engine. Phase = http_request_cache_settings entry point ruleset. Token: Zone Cache Settings Read / Cache Rules. Not paginated (rules[] inside one ruleset).
Verified via Workers Routes API docs. Workers Routes Read (Zone). Returns pattern -> script mappings for the zone. Returns full list (not cursor paginated).
Workers Scripts Read (Account). Lists deployed Worker scripts with metadata. Per-script settings: GET /accounts/{account_id}/workers/scripts/{script_name}/settings. Returns full list.
Workers Scripts Read. Returns the account's workers.dev subdomain. Per-script enablement: GET /accounts/{account_id}/workers/scripts/{script_name}/subdomain. Not paginated.
Workers Scripts Read. Cron triggers (schedules) for a Worker. Iterate per script from the scripts list. Not paginated.
Workers KV Storage Read. Lists KV namespaces (id, title). Paginates (page, per_page). Keys per namespace: GET .../namespaces/{namespace_id}/keys.
Workers R2 Storage Read. Lists R2 buckets (name, creation_date, location). Cursor-paginated (?cursor=, per_page).
D1 Read (Account). Lists D1 databases (uuid, name, version). Paginates (page, per_page). Note singular 'database' in the path.
Workers Queues Read (Account: Queues Read). Lists queues with producers/consumers. Paginates (page, per_page).
Pages Read (Account: Cloudflare Pages Read). Lists Pages projects with build config & domains. Paginates.

CURRENT endpoint (Audit Logs v2, GA path), verified in Cloudflare changelog 2025-03-27 + 2026 updates. NOT /audit_logs. Token: Account Audit Logs Read (Account Settings Read). Required filters since & before (RFC3339). Each entry includes actor (id/email/type), action, resource, method, interface (API/Dashboard), ray id — use for change attribution. Cursor-paginated. (Org-level equivalent: GET /organizations/{organization_id}/logs/audit. Legacy v1 used /accounts/{account_id}/audit_logs and is being retired.)
